correctness.rationale: For each integer n>=3 the full face lattice is reconstructed from disconnected triples. The cited grid shellability and Betti theorem (arXiv:2407.08158v1, Propositions 5.6, 5.8) ensures reduced homology is supported exactly in degree n^2-4 and is integral free, so a reduced signed Hopf trace equals its top rational character up to the known parity. Complementary nonfaces have sizes 0, 1, 2, connected 3-paths or unit 4-cycles. The invariant subset orientation signs give epsilon(g)(1-f+choose(f,2)-t-p+q). All five dihedral conjugacy class calculations are explicit and independently checked by direct all-face chain supertraces for n=3,4, and signed-path/square enumeration for n=3,...,12. Character inner products with the full D4 table produce the exact irreducible multiplicities for every n. Computation is corroboration, not an infinite proof; integral equivariant splitting is unproved and not claimed.

originality.rationale: The natural D4 action on the top rational homology of all square-grid ordinary three-cut complexes is an explicit parity-sensitive representation invariant not implied as an evaluated character by the published top-Betti and shellability results. Main paper Section 6 evaluates a different family of equivariant cut complexes; the other grid-focused paper deals with total cut and thin ordinary k-cut complexes. Both initial papers and the most relevant published database grid item were compared at statement and implication level. No covering character formula was found. A possible unindexed equivalent is a residual risk.
residual_risks: Semantic and bibliographic searches and inspected arXiv texts cannot rule out an unindexed equivalent character computation.

The published face-lattice formula makes the character computationally accessible by Hopf trace; the asserted originality is the evaluated all-order D4 class counts and irreducible decomposition rather than the general trace method.

Some related published online mathematical records were compared from indexed summaries only; none matched the same construction and k parameter closely enough to warrant treating a summary as exhaustive full-text evidence.

value.rationale: Square grids are canonical finite graphs with a distinguished D4 geometric action; the known Betti number supplies dimension but cannot recover symmetry eigenspaces or isotypic multiplicities. The closed all-n character distinguishes rotation, axial and diagonal reflections with nontrivial parity phenomena, and gives exact multiplicities of every rational irreducible, a complete motivated equivariant invariant. Its combination of signed fixed-path and invariant-square corrections is more substantial than a textbook scalar Betti count. No downstream applications or equivariant homotopy type are claimed without proof.
